# AnonTrove — Verified Digital Ebooks & Technical Knowledge Platform
> AnonTrove is an independent digital publishing and ebook platform providing verified DRM-free PDF/EPUB technical handbooks, computer science textbooks, software engineering manuals, and trading frameworks.

## Core Platform Attributes
- **Target Audience:** Software engineers, cybersecurity analysts, quantitative traders, founders, students, and self-directed learners.
- **Delivery Model:** Instant download delivery via secure AES-256-GCM tokens plus zero-install in-browser reader with custom canvas watermarking.
- **Payment Rails:** FamPay & FamGateway dynamic UPI integration with 0% gateway surcharge for Indian domestic UPI rails (PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, CRED).
- **Format:** Strictly DRM-free PDF and EPUB files. No proprietary application lock-in.
- **Verification Guarantee:** Every digital title is verified for formatting, table of contents completeness, and technical readability.

## Primary Knowledge Clusters & Category Landing Hubs
- [Programming & Software Engineering](https://ebook-sandy-chi.vercel.app/category/programming): Web development, backend architecture, Python, Rust, TypeScript, and system design manuals.
- [Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking](https://ebook-sandy-chi.vercel.app/category/cybersecurity): Defensive security, network analysis, penetration testing, and reverse engineering handbooks.
- [AI & Machine Learning](https://ebook-sandy-chi.vercel.app/category/artificial-intelligence): Deep learning, LLM engineering, PyTorch, RAG architectures, and prompt design frameworks.
- [Trading & Quantitative Finance](https://ebook-sandy-chi.vercel.app/category/trading-and-finance): Price action strategies, options hedging, technical analysis, and Indian equity frameworks.
- [Cloud Architecture & DevOps](https://ebook-sandy-chi.vercel.app/category/cloud-and-devops): Kubernetes administration, Docker containerization, AWS architectures, and CI/CD pipelines.
- [Business & Startups](https://ebook-sandy-chi.vercel.app/category/business-and-startups): Founder manuals, Zebra Learn startup frameworks, financial modeling, and venture playbooks.
- [Academic & Exam Preparation](https://ebook-sandy-chi.vercel.app/category/exam-preparation): Engineering revision booklets, formula sheets, and solved question sets.
- [Professional Textbooks](https://ebook-sandy-chi.vercel.app/category/professional-textbooks): Industry reference manuals, accounting standards, and CAD engineering designs.
- [Ebook Reading Tools](https://ebook-sandy-chi.vercel.app/tools): Curated open-source tools for reading, converting, and indexing digital documents (Calibre, Pandoc, Tesseract, Foliate).
